title: Mimico Application Boosted to Five Towers up to 54 Storeys
summary: Minto Communities GTA has submitted new Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment applications to the City of Toronto for a substantially expanded vision on a site near Mimico GO station dubbed Grand Park Village. Designed by Wallman Architects, the revised proposal replaces threee previously planned condominium towers that ranged from 23 to 42 storeys with five purpose-built rental towers rising from 34 to 54 storeys, introducing the tallest buildings yet proposed in the area.
